script_text: Stop, Aquarius — your Air-ruled world is about to shake at the very foundation without warning. Mars in Capricorn is forming a tense square to Uranus, your ruling planet, currently in Taurus, activating your 10th House of Career while destabilizing your 7th House of Partnerships. Saturn in Pisces is opposing your natal Pluto, forcing a raw conversation about power and trust to the surface today. If you're single, an unexpected connection crackles with chemistry but holds zero stability — let it pass before you emotionally invest. If taken, a disagreement about finances or shared responsibilities may expose a hidden vulnerability. A financial opportunity tied to your career is surfacing through your 10th House, but the Uranus square demands patience — verify every detail before committing. Do not sign contracts, loans, or proposals before midnight. Follow so you don't miss what's coming this week.
